pros: Q1 FY2026 ended June 2026: revenue ¥1,045.3bn, operating income ¥255.4bn. CFO ¥203.657bn less equipment ¥1.779bn and intangibles ¥13.119bn gives ¥188.759bn; after lease principal ¥10.660bn, ¥178.099bn. Neither is FCFF. SBC expense was ¥20.540bn; subtracting it illustratively yields ¥157.559bn, not normalized FCFF. Do not annualize this quarter.

HR Technology Q1 revenue rose 20.9% in USD versus 33.2% in JPY: translation matters. US average revenue per job grew 35%; segment EBITDA+S margin reached 47.4%. Staffing's margin was 6.2%, versus 6.6% previously. Japan outlook includes gross-to-net accounting changes and deliberate withdrawal from unprofitable business. Model each business separately before consolidation; the high-margin recruitment platform cannot justify applying its economics to staffing revenue. [Q1 summary](https://recruit-holdings.com/en/ir/library/upload/Recruit_202703Q1_summary_en.html).

Executed buybacks through October: 16,384,200 shares for ¥178.136bn against ¥350bn authority. Only 28,200 shares were bought in October. The period was extended to March 31, 2027. Remaining authorization is not cash already spent or free EPS growth. Refresh both cash and shares together. [November repurchase update](https://recruit-holdings.com/en/newsroom/20261102_0001/).
cons: The ADR close was $22.01 on November 6. The Tokyo ordinary closed at ¥17,000 earlier that day. BOJ's 17:00 JST USD/JPY range was 157.94–157.96; using its midpoint gives illustrative ADR parity of $21.526 and a 2.25% difference from the later US close. This is a non-synchronous currency/unit check, not an arbitrage premium or executable fair value. The current FX quote must not be confused with management's annual translation assumption. [ADR quote](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/RCRUY/), [ordinary history](https://markets.ft.markitdigital.com/data/equities/tearsheet/historical?s=6098%3ATYO), [BOJ](https://www.boj.or.jp/en/statistics/market/forex/fxdaily/fxlist/fx261106.pdf).

Liquidity is unresolved: Yahoo reports 468,005 shares for November 6 while the Deutsche Bank ADR directory reports 2,057,647. Neither is the required average over 20 sessions. Do not pass the ≥500,000-share average-volume gate from either daily observation or a three-month average. Resolve consolidated OTC coverage, retrieve 20 actual sessions, and verify spread and tradability. Ordinary-share liquidity does not substitute for ADR liquidity. [DB trading data](https://adr.db.com/drwebrebrand/dr-universe/dr_details.html?identifier=10994). EMA200, its slope, EMA50/200 relationship and price structure remain unverified.

Cash equivalents were ¥853.046bn, borrowings ¥0.658bn, leases ¥178.169bn and retirement liability ¥60.004bn. Cash less borrowings, ¥852.388bn, is not distributable excess cash. Issued shares less treasury including trusts equals 1,392,171,369; that is not a fully diluted denominator. Preserve trust awards and option dilution. August guidance: revenue ¥4,230bn, operating profit ¥945bn, parent profit ¥755bn, basic EPS ¥543 and SBC ¥78.9bn. [Q1 IFRS release](https://recruit-holdings.com/en/ir/library/upload/Recruit_202703Q1_earnings_en.html).

Management attributes growth to monetization and AI-enabled hiring productivity, but explicitly notes fast increases in client spending and forecasting uncertainty. The June 2026 Japan staffing antitrust inspection has no reasonably quantified financial impact and is excluded from guidance. This is a real unresolved risk, not an assumed zero.
